description: The Lineage Ground Master Frame Set is now available in 19.5" (Flatland Specific) and 20.5" (2018 Team Master Geo). Created to take a DNA strand or two from our past and thread it into state of the art contemporary designs of the present. Look at this masterpiece, from a glance its difficult to tell from the original 30 years prior. But when you look closely, you will see all modern technology. Hourglass Mid BB, internal head tube. Forks are full heat treated and butted with internal cable routing and 15mm offset. This Frame Set is as high level product you are going to buy in today's market.
